"""Generate temporary Yunxi PCM assets; import verified assets into firmware using WSL."""
import argparse
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import wave
import edge_tts


async def generate(args):
    phrases = dict(re.findall(r"^\s*(\w+)='([^']+)'", Path(__file__).with_name('generate_stability_sounds.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), re.M))
    if len(phrases) != 22:
        raise ValueError('Expected exactly 22 current firmware phrases')
    out = Path(args.output)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    rows = []
    for name, text in phrases.items():
        mp3, wav = out / (name + '.mp3'), out / (name + '.wav')
        await edge_tts.Communicate(text, 'zh-CN-YunxiNeural', rate='-8%', pitch='+0Hz').save(str(mp3))
        subprocess.run([args.ffmpeg, '-nostdin', '-v', 'error', '-i', str(mp3), '-ar', '16000', '-ac', '1', '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', str(wav)], check=True)
        with wave.open(str(wav)) as sound:
            assert (sound.getframerate(), sound.getnchannels(), sound.getsampwidth()) == (16000, 1, 2)
            seconds = sound.getnframes() / 16000
            assert 0 < seconds < 8, name
        rows.append(dict(file=wav.name, phrase=text, seconds=seconds, sample_rate=16000, channels=1, bits=16, sha256=hashlib.sha256(wav.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
        print('Generated', wav.name, round(seconds, 3), flush=True)
    (out / 'stability-voice-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(voice='zh-CN-YunxiNeural', rate='-8%', pitch='+0Hz', generator='edge-tts', files=rows), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--ffmpeg', required=True)
    asyncio.run(generate(parser.parse_args()))
